aboutMe.summary:
I am Jacky, a Technical Artist and game developer with a keen eye for visual expression. I care about how gameplay and visuals work together to shape the player experience: visuals should not only be engaging, but also make interactive feedback clearer and more expressive. I enjoy refining small but meaningful details that reward players with moments of discovery.

During development, I enjoy building lively real-time visual systems and finding a balance between artistic goals, performance, and engineering constraints. Through reusable shaders, VFX, and tools, I hope to help teams iterate faster and turn strong ideas into complete experiences.

highlights.value: Gameplay visuals, real-time shading, and interactive VFX.

highlights.value: Build reusable tools first, then polish with a strong art direction pipeline.

highlights.label: Current goal
highlights.value: Create performant technical art experiences that scale across teams.

highlights: Built a data-driven particle system with structured VFX parameters for programmatic and AI-assisted effect authoring.
Optimized CPU/GPU simulation and rendering, raising 25K-particle performance from 9 to 60 FPS (6.7×).
Improved an AI-assisted asset pipeline and built a visualization tool for 13 workflow nodes with live file I/O and agent logs.
Led an eight-person art team, established visual guidelines and an asset pipeline, and contributed to roughly 75% of the game’s visual assets and combat VFX.
Automated sprite processing with Python and image processing, reducing work from about one hour per animation to seconds.
Collaborated across art, design, and engineering on five boss encounters, balancing visual impact, readability, and performance.

experience.company: Cornell Bowers College of Computing and Information Science
highlights: Teaching Assistant for Introduction to Computer Game Architecture, a project-based course where programmers and designers collaborate to build a game.

profile.focusSummary: I build real-time visual systems at the intersection of graphics programming and technical art, focusing on data-driven VFX, procedural generation, asset pipelines, and CPU/GPU performance.

strings.Each fish’s motion is procedurally gener: Each fish’s motion is procedurally generated along a cubic Bézier curve, where the curve defines the fish’s silhouette and body deformation. The Bézier function provides relative body height at any position t, which determines the radius of each particle—each fish is composed of 150 particles, and their radii are dynamically calculated based on their positions along the curve. Parameters such as head, body, tail, and tip control the overall proportions, while TailEscalationIndex and TailOscillation modulate wave intensity. The body’s deformation is driven by traveling waves defined by wavelength, frequency, and speed, with orientation updated tangentially along the curve using Mat3 translation and rotation for smooth local-to-world pose transformations.
strings.Each ripple is an expanding ring that gr: Each ripple is an expanding ring that grows in tidy, discrete steps. A fixed step size and total step count shape how far it travels, while a small start delay or initial offset lets different ripples fire in a pleasing stagger. A lightweight frame-skip keeps the motion slow and silky instead of racing outward.
strings.Every frame we place a set number of ins: Every frame we place a set number of instanced particles evenly around the circle (uniform angles). We only update per-instance position, scale, and alpha—no geometry rebuilds—so frame rate stays high even with lots of overlapping ripples.

strings.The behavior of each fish is governed by: The behavior of each fish is governed by a modular behavior tree that manages transitions between different states such as patrolling, pursuing, feeding, and escaping. The system uses a shared blackboard to communicate conditions and environmental inputs, dynamically selecting the appropriate branch based on situational context. This structure allows each fish to react autonomously to stimuli—whether avoiding threats, seeking food, or idly exploring—creating varied and lifelike behavioral patterns within the simulation.

strings.The fish food system operates as a circu: The fish food system operates as a circular particle pool. We allocate 50 particles in total, but players can only spawn up to 20 visible particles at once.

strings.Toymare uses a built-in resource-managem: Toymare uses a built-in resource-management class and AssetsDirectory. aboutMe.summary:
我是 Jacky，一名技术美术与游戏开发者。我对视觉表达格外敏感，也关注玩法与视觉如何共同塑造玩家体验：视觉不仅要引人入胜，也要让交互反馈更清晰、更有感染力。我喜欢打磨那些细小却有意义的设计，让玩家在探索中发现惊喜。

开发时，我享受构建生动的实时视觉系统，也乐于在艺术目标、性能与工程限制之间寻找平衡。通过可复用的 Shader、VFX 和工具，我希望帮助团队更快迭代，把好的创意打磨成完整的体验。

experience.company: 腾讯游戏 · 光子工作室群
highlights: 从零构建数据驱动粒子系统，以结构化 VFX 参数支持程序化及 AI 辅助特效制作。
优化 CPU/GPU 模拟与渲染，使 2.5 万粒子场景的帧率从 9 FPS 提升至 60 FPS（6.7 倍）。
改进 AI 辅助资产流程，并为 13 个工作流节点制作可视化工具，展示实时文件 I/O 与智能体日志。

experience.role: 美术负责人 · 战斗设计负责人
experience.company: 康奈尔大学 Development in Games Association
highlights: 带领 8 人美术团队，制定视觉规范与资产流程，并参与制作约 75% 的游戏视觉资产及战斗特效。
用 Python 和图像处理自动化精灵图制作，将单个动画约一小时的处理时间缩短至数秒。
与美术、设计和工程团队合作完成 5 场首领战，兼顾视觉表现、玩法可读性与性能。

strings.Each fish’s motion is procedurally gener: 每条鱼的运动沿三次贝塞尔曲线程序化生成，曲线定义轮廓与身体形变。贝塞尔函数给出任意位置 t 的相对身体高度，用于决定各粒子的半径。每条鱼由 150 个粒子构成，粒子半径随曲线上位置动态计算。头部、身体、尾部和尾尖参数控制总体比例，TailEscalationIndex 与 TailOscillation 调节波动强度。身体形变由波长、频率和速度定义的行进波驱动，并通过 Mat3 平移和旋转沿曲线切向更新朝向，实现平滑的局部到世界空间姿态变换。
strings.Each ripple is an expanding ring that gr: 每道波纹都是按离散步长扩张的环形。固定步长与总步数决定传播距离；轻微的启动延迟或初始偏移使波纹错落出现。轻量级跳帧让运动缓慢柔和，而不是迅速向外扩散。
strings.Every frame we place a set number of ins: 每帧将固定数量的实例化粒子按均匀角度分布在圆周上。我们只更新每个实例的位置、缩放和透明度，无需重建几何体，因此大量波纹交叠时仍能保持帧率。

strings.The fish body geometry and motion are ge: 鱼体几何形状和运动由三次贝塞尔曲线生成，实现沿数学定义路径的平滑形变、自然摆动，以及从局部到世界空间的连续姿态变换。
strings.The fish food system operates as a circu: 鱼食系统采用循环粒子池，总共分配 50 个粒子，但玩家一次最多只能生成 20 个可见粒子。
strings.The last two comparisons use both a clos: 最后两组对比分别采用局部特写与完整画面，便于检查发光书页、人物和氛围背景中的噪声处理效果。
strings.The level-selection page uses green summ: 关卡选择页以绿色夏日和冬季主题区分章节与配乐，滚动地图引导玩家进入 Nox 的旅程。
strings.The menu aims for a lighthearted, cute a: 菜单通过动态插画营造轻松可爱的氛围。其运动以正弦和余弦计算振荡常数，再调整 UI 元素偏移实现。
strings.The original presentation also isolates: 原始演示文稿还单独展示了 2048 spp 下的纹理化光照结果。
strings.The particle system powers visual effect: 粒子系统驱动水波、拖尾和鱼食等视觉效果，通过对象池和逐实例更新维持高性能与自然流动感。
strings.These four points are used to construct: 这四个点实时构成新的贝塞尔矩阵，使鱼能平滑调整前进路线，保持流畅自然的运动。
strings.This project is an AI-driven biomimicry: 本项目是一个由 AI 驱动的仿生模拟，结合程序化动画、贝塞尔曲线插值和粒子系统，重现自然的水生行为。通过 AI 行为建模、程序化运动和粒子视觉效果，项目在数字生态中呈现仿生特征，让算法设计转化为有机且富有表现力的运动。
strings.Tiled is used to design 2D levels with t: 使用 Tiled 和图块集设计 2D 关卡。Toymare 的地图网格为 45 × 23 格；特殊格子标识障碍物、出生点和泥地。导出的关卡 JSON 会被解析，并将这些信息加载到 GameScene 类中。
strings.Time-based puzzle race built around envi: 围绕环境粒子与风格化 VFX 构建的计时解谜竞速游戏。
strings.Too many Mushrooms passing the towers br: 太多蘑菇越过防御塔，花园便会陷落。
strings.Towers cannot generate their own ammunit: 防御塔无法自行生产弹药。每一次射击都始于玩家种植、培育、收获并运送的作物。
strings.Toy Complete Animation with Bool Chain: 用布尔链制作玩具完成动画
strings.Toymare follows the Model-View-Control (: Toymare 遵循模型-视图-控制器（MVC）架构：对象定义在模型层，模型之间的交互由控制层处理。
strings.Toymare game artwork showing Nox and the: Toymare game artwork showing Nox and the warehouse
strings.Toymare uses a built-in resource-managem: Toymare 使用内置资源管理类与 AssetsDirectory。纹理在每个页面进入前初始化，经由构造函数传给下一页面，并从共享目录读取。玩家离开页面时释放该页面的目录，从而限制同时加载的纹理数量并改善内存管理。
strings.Toymare: game design, UI/UX, and program: Toymare: game design, UI/UX, and programming case study by Jacky Pan.
